title: Flatline zero-energy regression baseline (replay on known seeds)

identity.note: The probe always ran from the current checkout. A historical arm spec applied here is a settings replay, not a reproduction of its original figure.

preregistration.hypothesis: With every energy-giving pathway zeroed, all guilds go extinct. This is a REGRESSION CRITERION on a seed panel whose outcomes are already known, not a prospective ecological test: a deterministic replay of the same seeds and engine cannot confirm anything it did not already show.
preregistration.prediction: REPLAY CRITERION: all 36 seeds read pop = 0 at tick 12000. A prospective ecological claim would require a NEW seed panel registered BEFORE its outcomes are inspected; that panel is not yet registered and no verdict is claimed for it.
preregistration.falsification: Any of the 36 seeds reads pop > 0 at tick 12000 (would mean the correction is not deterministic, or extinction regressed).
preregistration.notPredicted: Extinction TIMING within the horizon is not predicted, only terminal state. Pre-0.6.0 extinction windows are earlier-engine evidence and are not comparable.
confoundsControlled: Same 36-seed panel as every prior flatline run (41001-41018, 31001-31018)
--zero only, no lifts, so the arm remains fully specified
Declared INPUTS controlled: seeds, horizon, and every zeroed pathway identical across runs.

NOT controlled — SCHEMA AND SEMANTICS CHANGED: the knob schema is NOT unchanged between 0.4.1 and 0.6.0. decomposerPhotoScale was ADDED, the guild capture gate gained a decomposer branch, and the mineralisation return gained an nCells divisor. Declared input values were held constant; engine semantics were not.
NOT controlled: the horizon changed from 6000 to 12000. This is a re-registration, not a matched comparison, and must not be read as one.
NOT independent: outcomes at 12000 were already observed on these seeds before the horizon was set. See registrationKind.
